mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_coin_order_history ( uuid , order_side , order_type , market , price , volume , order_time , profit_rate , loss_rate , time_limit , is_expired ) VALUES ( #{order.uuid} , #{order.side} , #{order.ordType} , #{order.market} , #{order.price} , #{order.volume} , NOW() , (SELECT value FROM tb_config WHERE "group" = 'ASK' AND key = 'profit_rate') , (SELECT value FROM tb_config WHERE "group" = 'ASK' AND key = 'loss_rate') , (SELECT value FROM tb_config WHERE "group" = 'ASK' AND key = 'time_limit') , true )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_coin_order_history SET is_expired = true WHERE market = #{market} AND (order_type = 'price' OR order_type = 'limit' OR order_type = 'best') AND order_side = 'bid'
UPDATE tb_coin_order_history SET is_expired = true WHERE order_type = 'limit' AND order_side = 'ask'
UPDATE tb_coin_order_history SET is_expired = true WHERE "uuid" = #{uuid}
UPDATE tb_coin_order_history SET is_canceled = true , is_expired = true WHERE "uuid" = #{uuid}
UPDATE tb_coin_order_history SET is_expired = true WHERE order_side = 'bid'
mapper.select: SELECT uuid , order_side , order_type , market , price , volume , order_time , profit_rate , loss_rate , time_limit , is_canceled , is_expired FROM tb_coin_order_history WHERE market = #{market} AND order_side = #{orderSide} AND order_type = #{orderType} AND is_canceled = false AND is_expired = false AND (NOW() - interval'5 seconds') > order_time ORDER BY order_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT uuid , order_side , order_type , market , price , volume , order_time , profit_rate , loss_rate , time_limit , is_canceled , is_expired FROM tb_coin_order_history WHERE order_side = 'bid' AND (order_type = 'price' OR order_type = 'limit' OR order_type = 'best') AND is_expired = false AND (NOW() - interval'5 seconds') > order_time ORDER BY order_time ASC

SELECT tcoh.market , ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(tcoh.uuid), ',') AS uuid_list FROM ( SELECT market AS market , "uuid" AS uuid FROM tb_coin_order_history ORDER BY order_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) tcoh GROUP BY tcoh.market
